I couldn't get the water depths, so I can't tell you which station is deepest. The NDBC site returned a "403 ERROR – Request blocked" page (a CloudFront block) every time I tried to load it in the browser.

I tried the station pages for 41001, 46026, 51001 and 42040, and then the ndbc.noaa.gov home page. All of them were blocked, so I saw no depth figures at all.

I didn't try to get around the block through data endpoints or outside sources, since you asked me to use only the site's own pages in the browser. I also won't answer from memory, because you asked for an answer based only on what I observed.

If you retry later, or the block is lifted for your network, I can rerun the same check.

ANSWER: unable to determine – ndbc.noaa.gov returned 403 Request blocked for all station pages
